H008 showed a very thin single embedding can contain at most one primitive irreducible per embedding, but global resultants could involve many moderately small factors. Fixed eta=.4 still fails the joint-smoothness model even with free polynomial processing; stronger eta=.1 has exact optimistic inequality witness:
a0=153/200,b0=189/200,delta=21/10,K=11/5,Q=9/5,
s=max(3a0-Q/delta²,2a0)=18491/9800,
u_required=b0+(K/delta+a0delta)/(3b0)=s-1343/238140,
max(s,2b0)=1.89.
These are necessary/sufficient-envelope inequalities conditional on actual population and useful smoothness/rank, NOT achieved density. Target set |Res(f,g)|^(5d) N^9 <= C0^(5d), C0=(3H)^d(d+1)A². d grows delta(logN/loglogN)^(1/3), logH=a0(logN)^(1/3)(loglogN)^(2/3).

Derive a genuinely sharper upper supply bound or constructive lower supply mechanism/certified diagnostic for this tail. Restrict primitive irreducibles and separately account reducibles/zero resultants. Could exploit homogeneous resultant as product of embedding linear forms, real versus complex roots, separation and actual ordinary-base coefficient structure; the crude dth-root union estimate may be very loose. But do not assume well-separated roots, generic coefficients, randomness of N digits, or fixed d bounds uniform in growing d. A proved conditional theorem with computable root/height conditions can be useful if it identifies a concrete N-only test/restart cost. A special-family counterexample alone does not reject a randomized field selection algorithm. Distinguish all-input base f, random N distribution, field selection, and exceptions.

Primary lead to inspect only if useful: https://arxiv.org/abs/1501.05767 Integral polynomials with small discriminants and resultants has fixed degree and varies both polynomials, so may NOT supply this uniform statement. Do not turn an upper bound into a lower population or assume success of Dickman heuristics for selected cancellation tails. No broad literature survey or quota of cards. Need a precise new lemma/construction/falsifier relevant to the narrow .1 parameter window. If no theorem settles it, isolate the exact missing uniform quantity and a decisive feasible future test; label inconclusive honestly.

Tiny-degree/H acceptance fractions are not useful density evidence because C0's slack can dominate. Do not run a full sieve or an adaptive parameter sweep. If a finite certified geometric test is truly necessary, preregister all input/seed/width/criterion/reference/budget hashes before one <=60s run, preserving failures/unstarted. No factor advice. Positive derivations await independent review, no novelty/factoring breakthrough claim. Verified factoring complexity improvement NONE.
